items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: we sent and got Claude Hopkinson. He came up and finished the job. So the three of us did that job.

ctx.x: -- Toronto. And the guy -- I forgot the guy that booked it, but he got an idea that it would be nice for them to have a horn, so they sent for me, and I went up to play. An alto and clarinet and two pianos, no drum, no rhythm section at all. We stayed there three weeks, and it was very nice. And -- but only thing, Don Ewell had a harder -- almost had a stroke, and he had to go in the hospital opening night, opening night.
And the second night and we sent and got Claude Hopkinson. He came up and finished the job. So the three of us did that job. And --
